_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 7: palette lists, blits, frame sync, pads, HUD score row, ship stats (several ranges). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: PALETTE LISTS, BLITS, FRAME SYNC, PADS (bank 7 `$D92D-$DB21`): palette list walker (`$D92D`, slot `$C05D`)
regions.description: The list at `($18)`: for position Y = 0..7 the byte is a palette number: `$FE` ends the list; `$FF` leaves the position alone; otherwise **`JSR $D76F` with `05 17 80` (bank 5 `$8018` -> `$B2E4`) copies palette A to `$0181 + 3Y`**.

regions.name: PALETTE LISTS, BLITS, FRAME SYNC, PADS (bank 7 `$D92D-$DB21`): next position
regions.description: `INY / CPY #8 / BNE`: at most eight positions.

regions.name: PALETTE LISTS, BLITS, FRAME SYNC, PADS (bank 7 `$D92D-$DB21`): list end
regions.description: The backdrop `$0180` := `$0F` (black) and `$017F` |= 3 (upload both palettes).

regions.name: PALETTE LISTS, BLITS, FRAME SYNC, PADS (bank 7 `$D92D-$DB21`): one fade step (`$D950`, slot `$C16E`)
regions.description: For the 24 palette bytes `$0181+Y` against the target `$04D0+Y`: equal is left; `$0F` (black) jumps to the target's hue at its darkest; the same hue is stepped up by `$10` while below the target; a different hue is stepped down by `$10` (to `$0F` on a borrow). `$15` counts the bytes still moving; `$017F` := 3.

regions.name: PALETTE LISTS, BLITS, FRAME SYNC, PADS (bank 7 `$D92D-$DB21`): blit a rectangle (`$D99C`, slot `$C07E`)
regions.description: `$15` wide x `$14` high bytes from `($16)` to the PPU address `$19:$18`: **one queue item per row** (width + 3 bytes, waiting for room), the address stepping one row down (`$DA1D`) each time; `$1B` counts 8 per row from the starting value Y and stops the blit at `$C0` (the bottom of the nametable).

regions.name: PALETTE LISTS, BLITS, FRAME SYNC, PADS (bank 7 `$D92D-$DB21`): move a PPU address (`$D9ED`, slot `$C081`)
regions.description: `$15` columns (signed) and `$14` rows (signed) added to `$19:$18`; Y follows as the attribute position (+1 or -1 every fourth column, +8 or -8 every fourth row).

regions.name: PALETTE LISTS, BLITS, FRAME SYNC, PADS (bank 7 `$D92D-$DB21`): one row down (`$DA1D`, slot `$C0E7`)
regions.description: `$19:$18` += `$20`; past the nametable's last row (`$C0` low byte in the page) the address wraps to the top of the same page (and the page toggles at the attribute-table boundary); `$DA4E` repeats `$DA56` (one row up) for a negative row count.

regions.name: PALETTE LISTS, BLITS, FRAME SYNC, PADS (bank 7 `$D92D-$DB21`): one row up (`$DA56`)
regions.description: `$19:$18` -= `$20` with the matching wrap.

regions.name: PALETTE LISTS, BLITS, FRAME SYNC, PADS (bank 7 `$D92D-$DB21`): wait a frame and read the pads (`$DA8B`, slot `$C0E4`)
regions.description: `LDY #1 / JSR $FFD1`, `JSR $D64C`; A := `$F5` (the new presses).

regions.name: PALETTE LISTS, BLITS, FRAME SYNC, PADS (bank 7 `$D92D-$DB21`): frame sync (`$DA9A`)
regions.description: A frame already passed (`$2B` non-zero) just clears `$2B` and returns. Otherwise, **with interrupts enabled it waits for the NMI; with them disabled by this routine (`SEI`) and sprites on, it spins on PPUSTATUS for the sprite-0 hit, does the split itself (`$DD21`) and, if the DMC IRQ did not fire (`$4015` bit 7), nudges the rate `$05` (at most `$89`)**; `$4015` := `$0F`, `CLI`, then spins until the NMI sets `$2B`, and clears it. This is the main thread doing the IRQ's job when it can.

regions.name: PALETTE LISTS, BLITS, FRAME SYNC, PADS (bank 7 `$D92D-$DB21`): pad cell and the demo's input (`$DAE1`, slot `$C02D`)
regions.description: `$30` bit 7 (a demo): the countdown `$F0:$F1` ends the demo (`JMP $FF4A`); `$F2` counts down the pattern's life and then picks the next pattern `$DB32[$F4]` (24-39 frames, `$F4` cycling 1-32); the pattern replaces all four pad bytes. Then, demo or not: **`$32` := `$DB22[($F7 OR $F8) AND $0F]`**, the pad cell (3 x column + row, 4 = none).

regions.name: HUD SCORE ROW (bank 7 `$E0F9`, `$E110`): the HUD pass (`$E0F9`, slot `$C153`)
regions.description: `JSR $E30C` (the life meter); the score row is redrawn only when the score counter `$40` is non-zero and on every 8th frame (`$41` AND 7 = 0), then `$40` := 0; `$41` (the frame counter of the game loop) += 1.

regions.name: HUD SCORE ROW (bank 7 `$E0F9`, `$E110`): the score row (`$E110`)
regions.description: An item of six digits from `$0170-$0175` to PPU `$2722` (row 25): **leading zeros are blanked (tile `$20`), the rest are the digit + `$30`**; no room in the queue returns and it is retried later.

regions.name: SHIP STATS, CHIPS, WEAPON COST (bank 7 `$FCE7-$FDC9`, `$FDF8`): the ship's entry point (`$F269`)
regions.description: The ship's x := `$F278[$A4]` and y := `$F279[$A4]`, `$A4` being the exit just used (0 N, 2 W, 4 none, 6 E, 8 S): **N (`78`, `90`), W (`DC`, `70`), none (`80`, `90`), E (`28`, `70`), S (`78`, `38`)** - the ship appears on the side opposite the exit.

regions.name: SHIP STATS, CHIPS, WEAPON COST (bank 7 `$FCE7-$FDC9`, `$FDF8`): add chips (`$FCE7`, slot `$C12F`)
regions.description: Chips `$4D:$4C` += A; overflow or above the maximum `$4F:$4E` clamps to the maximum; then `JSR $FD77` (the selected weapon's level and cost), `JSR $E1C3` (print the uses left) and `JMP $E213` (the gun tier and the chip counter).

regions.name: SHIP STATS, CHIPS, WEAPON COST (bank 7 `$FCE7-$FDC9`, `$FDF8`): attack, shield and speed (`$FD0E`, slot `$C132`)
regions.description: **The ship's attack `$05A8` := `$FD4A[$4A]` = 1, 2, 3, 5 for attack levels 1-4 (capped at 4). `$0590` (the damage divisor) := the shield level `$4B` (capped at 7).** A shield level of 0 gives attack 64, divisor 32. **The speed class `$0698` := `$FD4F[i]` = `03 05 41 06` with i = 0 for shield under 5, 2 for 5 or more, +1 in a corridor: so a shield of level 5 or more speeds the ship up (labyrinth class 3 -> `$41`, corridor 5 -> 6).** RUN: all of it.

regions.name: SHIP STATS, CHIPS, WEAPON COST (bank 7 `$FCE7-$FDC9`, `$FDF8`): flickering arrival (`$FD53`, slot `$C009`)
regions.description: `$0788,X` zero returns to the handler. Otherwise the handler is abandoned (two return addresses dropped), `$0788` counts down, and only the odd values draw (`JMP $CBFC`): the 40-60 frame flicker.

regions.name: SHIP STATS, CHIPS, WEAPON COST (bank 7 `$FCE7-$FDC9`, `$FDF8`): add life (`$FD67`, slot `$C00C`)
regions.description: `$48` += A, capped at `$FF` and at `$47`.

regions.name: SHIP STATS, CHIPS, WEAPON COST (bank 7 `$FCE7-$FDC9`, `$FDF8`): the selected weapon (`$FD77`, slot `$C135`)
regions.description: `$45` := 0; `$3D` := the level of weapon `$3C` (via `$E498`; 0 for none); `$3B` := `$FDCA[$3C]` (the highest slot below the A weapon's objects); weapon 0 or level 0, or the Eraser (12: the stock `$04AF`) goes straight to `$3E`; else **the chip cost `$45` := `$FDD3[3 x weapon + level]`**.

regions.name: SHIP STATS, CHIPS, WEAPON COST (bank 7 `$FCE7-$FDC9`, `$FDF8`): uses left (`$FDAA`, slot `$C138`)
regions.description: `$3E` := chips / cost: 255 if the chips' high byte is at least the cost; a cost with bit 7 halves both before the 16-bit divide (`$F9BA`).

regions.name: SHIP STATS, CHIPS, WEAPON COST (bank 7 `$FCE7-$FDC9`, `$FDF8`): set up a beam piece (`$FDF8`, slot `$C13B`)
regions.description: A = a style record offset (3 n) into `$FE22`; Y = the new object: **metasprite `$0548` := byte 0, `$0638` := byte 1, `$0650` (the half-width) := byte 2; flags `$0620` and attribute `$0560` := 0, hit points `$FF`, attack 1**.
